metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover around Depok lower in 2019 than in 1990?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Depok (city in Indonesia, near Jakarta) - Time periods: 1990 vs 2019 - Collection: For 1990, need Landsat 5; for 2019, need Landsat 8 or Sentinel-2 - Metric: Vegetation cover - use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds to get clean vegetation signals - Use QA bands for cloud masking 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: NDVI can legitimately be low/near zero (bare soil, water) - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If NDVI calculation yields None/NaN or values outside [-1, 1] - Compare mean NDVI: if 2019 < 1990, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Depok location (city center coordinates) const depok = ee.Geometry.Point([106.8294, -6.4025]).buffer(10000); // 10km radius // 2. Get 1990 data (Landsat 5) let col1990 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(depok) .filterDate('1990-01-01', '1990-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1990 = col1990.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1990 Images found: ${size1990}`); if (size1990 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 5 data for 1990'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get 2019 data (Landsat 8) let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(depok) .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images found: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 8 data for 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Cloud masking function for Landsat Collection 2 function maskL8sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); const opticalBands = image.select(['SR_B.']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true) .updateMask(qaMask) .updateMask(saturationMask); } function maskL5sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); const opticalBands = image.select(['SR_B.']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true) .updateMask(qaMask) .updateMask(saturationMask); } // 5. Calculate NDVI for both periods function addNDVI_L5(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } function addNDVI_L8(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const ndvi1990 = col1990.map(maskL5sr).map(addNDVI_L5).select('NDVI').median(); const ndvi2019 = col2019.map(maskL8sr).map(addNDVI_L8).select('NDVI').median(); // 6. Calculate statistics const stats1990 = ndvi1990.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: depok, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1990 = stats1990['NDVI_mean']; const count1990 = stats1990['NDVI_count']; console.log(`1990: Mean NDVI = ${mean1990}, Valid pixels = ${count1990}`); if (count1990 === 0 || count1990 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 1990 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean1990 === null || mean1990 === undefined || mean1990 < -1 || mean1990 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation for 1990'); console.log('C3'); return; } const stats2019 = ndvi2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: depok, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2019 = stats2019['NDVI_mean']; const count2019 = stats2019['NDVI_count']; console.log(`2019: Mean NDVI = ${mean2019}, Valid pixels = ${count2019}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2019 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2019 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean2019 === null || mean2019 === undefined || mean2019 < -1 || mean2019 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation for 2019'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare and determine answer console.log(`Vegetation change: ${((mean2019 - mean1990) / mean1990 * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (mean2019 < mean1990) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
